company_url.title: Company URL
company_url.description: LinkedIn company page URL. The actor also tries common slug variants if this URL is unavailable.

linkedin_email.title: LinkedIn email
linkedin_email.description: Optional. If empty, LINKEDIN_EMAIL from .env or environment variables is used.

linkedin_password.title: LinkedIn password
linkedin_password.description: Optional. If empty, LINKEDIN_PASSWORD from .env or environment variables is used.

max_pages.title: Maximum people pages
max_pages.description: Maximum number of employee result pages to scrape.

decision_makers_only.title: Decision makers only
decision_makers_only.description: When enabled, only save records classified as decision makers.

max_profiles_to_enrich.title: Maximum profiles to enrich
max_profiles_to_enrich.description: Maximum number of likely decision-maker profiles to visit for current experience extraction.

profile_delay_min_seconds.title: Minimum profile delay seconds
profile_delay_min_seconds.description: Minimum random delay before opening a candidate profile.

profile_delay_max_seconds.title: Maximum profile delay seconds
profile_delay_max_seconds.description: Maximum random delay before opening a candidate profile.

headless.title: Headless browser
headless.description: Set false when LinkedIn asks for manual security verification so you can complete the challenge in the browser/live view.

manual_verification_timeout_seconds.title: Manual verification timeout seconds
manual_verification_timeout_seconds.description: How long to wait when LinkedIn shows a security checkpoint. Use with headless=false, complete the challenge, and rerun with the same session_id.

use_apify_proxy.title: Use Apify Proxy
use_apify_proxy.description: Enable Apify Proxy for browser traffic.

proxy_groups.title: Proxy groups
proxy_groups.description: Apify Proxy groups to use when proxy is enabled.

session_id.title: Session ID
session_id.description: Stable value used for fingerprint/proxy session and stored login state.
